name: dev-kit
description: Opinionated Claude Code workflow kit: Context7 + Serena MCPs, planning/research/review subagents, three baseline hooks, and a project bootstrapper. Cross-machine consistent.

context7_api_key.title: Context7 API key
context7_api_key.description: Get a free key at https://context7.com/dashboard for higher rate limits. Leave blank to use the free tier.

enable_autoformat.title: Auto-format files after edits
enable_autoformat.description: Run prettier/black/gofmt/rustfmt after Claude writes or edits a file (if installed).

enable_bash_guard.title: Block destructive bash commands
enable_bash_guard.description: Block rm -rf, force-pushes to protected branches, chmod 777, and similar.

enable_session_context.title: Inject project context on session start
enable_session_context.description: On SessionStart, inject git branch, recent commits, uncommitted changes, and open TODOs.
